div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://awatson1978.github.io/aerospace-medicine-ig/CodeSystem/space-adverse-event-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: Inability to void bladder, common side effect of promethazine and scopolamine
Sedation impairing crew performance, common with promethazine IM
Dystonia, akathisia, or other movement disorders from antiemetic use
Cardiac QT interval prolongation associated with ondansetron or promethazine
Anticholinergic dry mouth from scopolamine or promethazine
